entries.note: Diagnostic adapter for NWN2 GOG SDK 1.152.10 and the exact Nucleus Nemirtingas 0.8.5 binary. A separate IUser proxy preserves the backend object and its vtable. x64 tail-call thunks replace RCX with the real object and preserve all other registers/stack arguments, including MSVC hidden return buffers. New SignInAuthorizationCode adds slot15; old IsLoggedOn/RequestEncryptedAppTicket/GetEncryptedAppTicket slots24/25/26 map to new25/26/27. New SignInGalaxy adds a timeout before the listener; the C thunk drops that timeout. Unsupported methods raise a visible diagnostic exception rather than pretending success. This is a bounded NWN2 adapter, not a full implementation of every new GOG interface. Client/server IUser objects are separate. Backend exports are forwarded by ordinals pinned to the bundled binary in galaxy_compat.def. Isolated compat-mode probe verified auth callback, logged-on state and 107-byte ticket. Full-game initialization succeeded and the user confirmed hosting/joining on2026-09-13 after the IStats mapping was added. Pointer-only sign-in and access-violation diagnostics record addresses, never ticket or credential contents. The vectored handler returns CONTINUE_SEARCH and does not swallow game exceptions.

The original 1.152.10 binary IStats vtable at RVA0xa408f8 contains three extra methods at slots7/8/9: GetAchievementsNumber/GetAchievementName/GetAchievementNameCopy. They are absent from the older online documentation and bundled emulator table at RVA0x4b9868. New GetAchievement slot10 incorrectly reached old StoreStatsAndAchievements slot10 and queued the ACH_NEVER... name as a callback, later crashing at backend+0x2d4ff with RDX=0x4556454e5f484341. Map new slots10..37 to old7..34; preserve0..6. The three unimplemented enumeration methods raise the diagnostic unsupported exception. Methods were verified from original and emulator binary function-name strings, not inferred solely from the outdated web header.
